tools.name: create_sound
tools.description: Build a notification sound from your own layer design and get an editor link for it. The link opens the sound in the editor, where the user plays, tweaks and downloads it. Returns the link, the stored sound and warnings for any value that was out of range, rounded or ignored. Read get_sound_guide fi

tools.name: read_sound
tools.description: Turn a share link (or the code after #s=) back into the sound design, to change it and call create_sound again.

tools.name: list_library_sounds
tools.description: List the built-in sounds by group, or search them by name. Without arguments it lists every group with its sound names. Use a close built-in sound as a starting point.

tools.name: get_library_sound
tools.description: Get the full design of a built-in sound and its editor link, to use as a starting point for create_sound.

tools.name: get_sound_guide
tools.description: How sounds are built: layers, envelope, pitch, timing, noise, levels and effects, with example designs. Read it once before designing.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_sound · Public sink: read_sound.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_sound · Public sink: read_sound

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
